question: What will be the area of the ring-shaped region enclosed between two concentric circles of radii 14 cm and 7 cm?
solution:
**Given**

Radii of two concentric circle = 14 cm and 7 cm

**Formula used**

Area of ring = π(R² - r²)

where R and r are outer circle ind inner circle radii.

(a² - b²) = (a - b) ( a + b)

**Calculation**

Area of ring shaped region = π(R² - r²)

⇒ (22/7) × (14² - 7²)

⇒ (22/7) × (14 - 7) × (14 + 7)

⇒ (22/7) × 7 × 21

⇒ 22 × 21

⇒ 462 cm²

**∴ The area of the ring-shaped region enclosed between two concentric circles of radii 14 cm and 7 cm will be 462 cm².**
